ammonia.reason: Limited amino acid deamination by LAB/non-starter LAB at aw ~0.94 and dry-salted pressed curd.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw cow milk pasture-derived p-cresol/indole plus propionic acid from lactate fermentation.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from uninhibited chymosin/plasmin proteolysis accentuated by 2-3% NaCl.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no blue-mold methyl-ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard from residual galactose/lactose plus proteolysis peptides when grated and heated.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism diminished by salt and long aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: High free butanoic up to 1500 mg/kg plus hexanoic from milk lipase and microbial lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: Low moisture ~35.6% and high protein ~28-30% give dry granular mouthfeel, not fat-emulsion cream.

crumbliness.reason: Low pH 5.1-5.4 calcium-solubilized paracasein plus pressing, salting and aging fracture.

firmness.reason: Pressed, dry-salted, aged low-moisture 32-42% matrix with dense cross-linked casein.

floral_honey.reason: Very low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism in salty low-aw curd.

fruity.reason: Limited ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esterification by LAB esterases under low moisture/high salt.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only, no goat branched medium-chain acids; only low caproic/caprylic from lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine plus proteolysis nuttiness.

melt.reason: Low pH, low moisture and ~2.35% salt restrict paracasein hydration and flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No bloomy/Geotrichum flora; negligible 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: ~29% fat largely entrapped in hard aged protein network, little free oil release.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol deposition process.

sour_vinegar.reason: Very high free acetic 548-3600 mg/kg from heterofermentative LAB lactose/lactate and citrate metabolism.

stretch.reason: Rennet curd not pasta-filata; no hot-water kneading or aligned demineralized casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No curd cooking and low methionine catabolism to methanethiol/dimethyl sulfides/methional.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted by fermentation and sweetness masked by acid plus high NaCl.

umami.reason: Free glutamate accumulation from calf chymosin plus plasmin/ LAB peptidase proteolysis over months.
